summary: Join our Principles of Contract Drafting and Negotiation Training Course to develop essential skills for drafting clear contracts and negotiating effectively.
lede: Contract drafting and negotiation training helps professionals who work with agreements draft, review and negotiate clearer terms. It covers structuring contracts, interpreting key commercial clauses, spotting red flags, and managing liability and other risks. Participants also practise preparing negotiation positions, comparing redlines, and communicating trade-offs with internal stakeholders and counterparties.
audienceIntro: This course is tailored for professionals who regularly engage with contracts, even if they are not legal specialists. It offers insights and skills for those involved in drafting, reviewing, or negotiating contracts across various sectors.
modules: Foundations of Contract Law and Commercial Agreements
Risk Allocation: Liability, Indemnity, and Warranties
Contract Review, Redlining, and Markup Skills
Contracts in the Public, NGO, and Donor-Funded Contexts
prerequisites: Participants should have basic experience with contracts or agreements in a professional setting. No prior legal training is required.
